slot_note: Re-root of architecture 3, and the first re-root on this number that moves the world as well as the decisive step. All three earlier architectures made the decisive quantity an unobserved component of an observed total, the plant's own share of the sound at a dwelling; that component is readable when a window supplies it (architecture 2) and indeterminate when a fit supplies it (architecture 3), and this world has no third source. Physical and environmental sciences against this objective is also the lane's most crowded ground (task180, task189 and this slot all on environmental monitoring exceedance), so the task type moves too.
niche: the first-decision time distribution of a scholarly publisher's editorial desks, where the submissions platform exposes only live manuscripts to reporting and the analytics desk's whole history of durations is a run of weekly snapshots of what was under review that day
stakeholder_role: the publisher's head of editorial operations, who sets the quarter's editorial process review slate

spine.entity: one manuscript as it stood in one Monday extract of everything under review that day

world.org_type: a scholarly publisher whose twelve subject desks run peer review on one submissions platform, and whose reporting view holds only manuscripts still live

driver: The decisive quantity is a summary of how long a unit's items take, and the only record of that duration is a run of snapshots of whatever was still in progress on each observation date, so an item enters the record with probability proportional to its own duration and the recorded distribution is the duration-weighted one rather than the population's; the weighting inflates the long tail by each unit's own spread of durations, so units whose durations are widely spread are inflated most and the ranking of tail shares moves, while deduplicating the record to distinct items leaves the weighting untouched.
driver_concrete: Each desk is ranked on the share of its manuscripts whose first decision takes longer than the house standard, and the platform's reporting view holds only live manuscripts, so the analytics desk's history is a run of Monday snapshots in which a manuscript appears once for every week it was under review; the distinct manuscripts those snapshots contain over-represent slow ones in proportion to their own review time, by more at the desks whose review times are widely spread, so the tail shares read off the snapshots rank the wrong desks onto the slate.
stump: The wrong committed answer is the slate filed from the tail shares of the snapshot record itself, whether the rows are pooled or deduplicated to distinct manuscripts, because a manuscript enters that record once per week it was live and the record is therefore the duration-weighted distribution; the inflation is largest at the desks whose review times are most widely spread, so those desks are pushed up the ranking and the desks that genuinely breach the standard most often are pushed off the slate. The exact wrong set and the margins are filed at stage 2 when the ladder is measured, against the rule that every graded figure is checked for determinacy to the printed unit across every route the data does not close.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who dedupes the snapshot rows to distinct manuscripts, reconciles the platform's own identifiers, handles the reopened and withdrawn cases and reads every clause of the editorial standard correctly still computes each desk's tail share on the set of manuscripts the snapshots contain, and files the wrong slate, because that set is sampled in proportion to review time; only weighting each manuscript by the reciprocal of its own time under review, which is what the snapshot mechanism implies, recovers the desks' own distributions and the committed slate.
domain_test: What decides the slate is the distribution of a duration and the sampling mechanism the record was produced by, which is this task type's own statistical object: a snapshot of work in progress observes each item with probability proportional to its length, so the recorded distribution is the length-biased one and the population's is recovered by un-weighting. Put another field's nouns in and the task only reads the same if the record is still a run of snapshots of unfinished work, because it is the mechanism and not the subject that decides.
layer1: the platform's reporting view holds only live manuscripts, so a duration is assembled across snapshots
a manuscript appears once per snapshot week, so the row count is not a manuscript count
two snapshot weeks missing where the extract did not run, and one taken on a Tuesday
manuscripts that move desk mid-review, so the desk a row carries is the desk it was on that week
revise-and-resubmit cases that re-enter under a new identifier the platform links in a separate table
withdrawn and transferred manuscripts, which never reach a first decision
the platform's own clock in UTC against the editorial calendar in local time
a mid-window change in how the platform stamps the decision date

differentiation.task228: Shares the gap, the decision type and the Gate G mechanism with task228 architecture 2, and nothing else. task228's decisive quantity is each unit's own random measurement error against a latent signal, where two comparators share an input in one region so their errors co-vary there; the comparison is between measuring instruments. Here there is one instrument and no comparator: the instrument damps the quantity it measures while measuring it, and the decisive move is reading the rate at placement off each deployment's own approach to its asymptote. One is error covariance across comparators, the other is a measurand that falls because it is being measured, and neither route reaches the other's answer.
differentiation.task182: Against this slot's own architectures 1 to 3, which share one shape: in every one the decisive quantity was an unobserved component of an observed total, the plant's own share of the sound at a dwelling, reached through a lagged driver, a plant-off window and a fitted intercept in turn. Architecture 4 has no latent component and no subtraction: every duration it needs is recorded, and what is wrong with the record is the probability with which an item enters it. The world, the domain, the task type, the spine and the decision's object all move with it.
differentiation.task187: The nearest curved-response build on file. task187 averages a capped, curved response over a spread of inputs whose width differs by unit, which is an aggregation effect across a distribution of inputs at one instant. Here the response is not curved in the input but in time, and only because the measurement feeds back on the thing measured, so the bias is set by the apparatus's time constant against the window length rather than by the spread of any input.
differentiation.task189: Shares the family of incomplete observation and nothing of the mechanism. task189's measurements are known only to lie below a limit that differs by instrument, so values are truncated and the decisive work is an estimator for censored values. Architecture 4's durations are all fully observed; what is distorted is which items are in the record at all, and the correction is a weight rather than a substitute value.
differentiation.task462: Shares methane as the measured gas. task462 conforms repeated aerial plume survey estimates into a production-weighted intensity, an ETL build whose difficulty is the definition of the denominator and the vintage of each survey. Here the measurement is a static chamber on a restoration layer and the difficulty is the estimator for one deployment's rate.
differentiation.task186: The nearest build on a monitored level against its own surroundings. task186 tests each unit's change across an event against what the event alone would leave, where the units' levels swing in local cycles shared within a place, so its decisive quantity is the reference distribution for a difference. Here there is no change and no test: the quantity is one source's share of a level that is the energetic sum of two sources, and the decisive move is which windows measure the other one.
differentiation.task263: The nearest driver on file (0.07) and the closest in words: a source's own level recovered from mixtures. task263 mixes many sources in proportions that change between measurements and separates them by a mass balance across the mixtures, a linear system over several unknowns, and its wrong routes over-credit clean sources. Here the mixture has exactly two parts, the works and everything else, it is energetic rather than proportional, and nothing can be inverted: the second part is unobservable while the first runs, so the decisive move is which windows of the same record measure it, and the wrong routes understate the source by the surroundings' own variability.
differentiation.task234: Shares the shape of recovering what one source contributed to a reported figure. task234's quantity is what a source produced when a transit loss removed part of its output, read from a share its own output cannot move, which is a maturity and completeness mechanism. Nothing is lost or late here: every minute is recorded, and the question is which minutes measure the part of the total that is not the works.
differentiation.task192: Shares nothing but the shape of the words 'measured in one window, applied to another'. task192's decisive quantity is a count of units carrying a property an instrument labels, where the instrument's validation batch covered only the window's opening and the population's class mix moved after it, so the question is which of the instrument's rates carry forward to a cohort the batch never reached. Architecture 3 carries nothing forward at all: its right route never transports a measurement between windows, it identifies the in-window quantity from the source's own recorded output, and what shifts is the composition of the nuisance sound by hour of the day at a fixed set of receptors, with the shift's sign differing by receptor. No cohort, no instrument performance and no rate transport appears in it.
differentiation.task451: Shares the decisive gap, the pattern slot and the Gate G mechanism with task451's architecture 1 and nothing of the move. task451 v1's decisive quantity is money credited back to original sources through an intermediary that collects in one period and pays out in the next, so the mix that applies to a payment is a previous period's inflow mix and the work is an accounting reallocation of a flow across periods. Architecture 3's decisive quantity is a physical level at a fixed receptor, obtained by subtracting a nuisance term from a measured total; nothing is reallocated and nothing lags, the work is identifying a term that cannot be observed in the window the estimand names, and what makes the observable estimate wrong is that the nuisance sound is a different mixture of its own sources at the only hours the plant can be seen shut down, with the difference's sign changing from receptor to receptor.
differentiation.task190: task190's architecture 3 also turned on a selection probability, but the opposite way round and by a stated design: items were drawn into a tested set with probability proportional to size under a sampling plan, and the decisive work was recovering the plan's own selection amount from the tested set, so a solver had to find a rule the pack never states. Architecture 4 has no sampling plan and no rule to recover: the weighting is an accident of a reporting view that holds only live records, every duration is in the pack, and the work is recognising that a snapshot of unfinished work observes an item in proportion to its length. task190's architecture 1 is the Little's law product of a rate and a duration, which this does not compute.
differentiation.task265: The nearest build on file and still a different mechanism. task265's record opens partway through, so units that started earlier are in it only if they were still event-free when it first saw them, and the correction is where each unit enters the risk set: every unit is counted once and the distortion comes from when observation begins. Architecture 4's record is a run of repeated snapshots of unfinished work, so an item is seen if it was live on any snapshot date and the distortion comes from how many chances it had to be seen, which is its own duration; every duration is fully observed, nothing is censored or truncated, and the correction is a reciprocal-duration weight. The error is also unit-specific in size, through each desk's own spread of durations, which is what moves the ranking, where left truncation understates monotonically.
differentiation.task139: Shares the decisive gap and the Gate G mechanism and nothing else. task139's decisive quantity is an intervention's effect read per assigned unit rather than per recorded case, because the intervention changes how many units become recorded cases as well as what they cost, so the work is choosing the denominator of a randomised comparison and valuing it per unit of capacity. Architecture 4 has no intervention, no arms and no denominator choice: the population of items is fixed and fully recorded in duration, and what is wrong is the probability each item had of appearing in the record at all.
differentiation.task452: task452's architecture 2 is a design-weighting problem with stated inclusion probabilities: observations were drawn from a preliminary classification under stratum-specific probabilities, the classification was then revised, and the work is reweighting observations whose own stratum changed. Architecture 4 has no sampling design, no strata and no stated probabilities. Its weighting is an accident of a reporting view that holds only live records, the implied probability is each item's own duration rather than a design constant, and the correction is read off the observation mechanism rather than off a revised frame.

lineage.fate: shipped 2026-10-11 and solved on the portal, so FAILED_TO_STUMP; spent as an architecture on 2026-10-17. The portal executed the decisive rung as a work order: the in-house round already held the pre-take-calibration-and-run-forward construction and only wanted a better regressor, the isolated leak reader reached the answer with a lagged-rainfall model on the pack alone, and the pack shipped a 13,422 day rainfall and evaporation series no graded figure or ask reads, which is a file whose presence is the hint. The WHAT screen kills it besides: the decisive step was which level the observed level is set against, which is the estimand's comparison, so filing it makes the computation follow from the clause and leaving it unfiled leaves the call open. The shared-driver mechanism is spent in its own right.
lineage.driver: When every unit's level follows a shared external driver through its own lagged response, a change measured from a fixed baseline mixes that response with the effect being assessed, so the effect is the gap between the observed level and each unit's own driver-only path fitted before the effect began, which hides large effects where the driver was lifting the level and invents them where it was pulling it down.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each landholder bore's September 2026 assessment level is set against the make-good trigger for its aquifer (2 m in the alluvium, 5 m in the coal measures and basalt) since the pit's dewatering began on 4 July 2022; the alluvial bores fell 4.6 to 5.2 m through the failed 2022-23 to 2025-26 seasons on rainfall alone, while the coal-measure bores near the pit, still rising on the 2019-20 and 2020-21 wet seasons through a six to seven year rainfall memory, were drawn 8.3 to 9.3 m below where that rise was taking them and show only 2.2 to 2.5 m of net decline.
lineage.stump: A competent solver converts every dip and logger reading to a reduced level, compares each bore's September 2026 level with its baseline assessment (or with the reference bores' change, or with the far-field coal-measure bore KV-LB16 as a control) and offers make good to the alluvial bores and the ridge basalt bore that fell past their triggers (or to KV-LB12 alone, or to KV-LB04, KV-LB05 and KV-LB12); the step that lands it there is reading the decline since the baseline as the mine's, when the alluvium and basalt fell through the dry seasons and the coal measures' small net fall hides 8.3 to 9.3 m of drawdown under a rise the wet seasons had set going.
lineage.answer: Offer make-good agreements to four owners for five bores: Yarrowmere Pastoral Co Pty Ltd for KV-LB04 and KV-LB05 (one agreement), Tondara Grazing Pty Ltd for KV-LB07, Bluebush Downs Pty Ltd for KV-LB10 and Cypress Ridge Pastoral Trust for KV-LB12.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-17 without shipping: both stage 4 cold threads landed the call. The isolated reader, on the prompt and the 13 files alone, named the five with their levels, the sixth and its margin, the tone and both device asks, at about 70 per cent confidence on the call; the determinism judge returned DETERMINISTIC with Gate F read LOW to MODERATE and too-easy risk named on the main call, and derived the same answer. The decisive step was readable: clause 3.1 obliged every solver to produce a residual and the pack offered exactly one place to get one, labelled in the equipment log's own words as the weekly MCC inspection, so the step the filed clause demanded and the data supplied in one move was found by both threads. The ask layer's measured pair ceiling of 37.3 proved nothing, because a pair ceiling cannot validate the ladder it assumes (the rule this wave filed from task190). Evidence kept in the task folder: determinism_check_report.md and leak_check_report.md's Solver's-eye read.
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is one source's own contribution to a measured total, and the nuisance part of that total cannot be measured while the source runs, because the source's steady presence lifts even the quietest moments of the record; so every background taken from the running record subtracts the source along with the nuisance and leaves the nuisance's own variability, ranking the units by how variable their surroundings are instead of by how much the source contributes.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-18 at the feasibility check, before a row was cut. The decisive step was sound: the stop-window residual swapped NSL01 in for NSL13 and moved the sixth from NSL06 to NSL14 at every modelled plant-load design, the wrong route's fifth-to-sixth margin 2.12 dB against the right route's 0.65. But the estimator had no determinate form. Energy-linear, decibel-linear, lowest-decile, log-log and lowest-output-quarter fits all filed the same five and the same sixth, so the fit could not be a rung, while moving every graded level by 0.9 to 1.8 dB, nine to eighteen times the printed unit, so the fourteen levels and the margin were not determinate. The tension is structural: the intercept is identifiable only through the curvature of level against output, which is the same curvature that makes a decibel fit disagree with an energy fit, so widening the output range widens the disagreement and narrowing it buries the intercept in noise. Three fit-free replacements were worked and all three failed. Numbers in the design note's ARCHITECTURE 3 FEASIBILITY section.
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is one continuously running source's own share of a measured total at each receptor, and the nuisance term it is netted against is directly observable only in a window outside the one the estimand names, where the nuisance is a different mixture of its own constituents; that mixture's shift has opposite sign at different receptors, so the directly observable estimate inflates some and deflates others and mis-ranks them, while the term that holds is identified inside the named window from the source's own recorded output.

notes: Architecture 4 draw. The two rules this slot earned are carried into it: a supplemental device may never touch the call's own construction, and every graded figure's determinacy is checked against the printed unit across every route the data does not close, before any data is cut. Two axes redrawn at the guard after registration: context_artifact filed_standard to close_out_summary and forum executive_team to line_manager_or_team, both BLOCKed by axis bans against task161. The close-out pack carries submission volumes and editor headcount and no turnaround figure, so it frames the quarter-close decision without ranking the desks on the question (Gate G).
